sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: In the poem 'My Bicycle', what sound does the bicycle bell make?
Identify the proper noun in this sentence: 'Raju is going to the park.'
How did the clever crow drink the water from the pitcher?
options: B) By dropping pebbles into it
questions.answer: B) By dropping pebbles into it

questions.question_text: Which pronoun should replace the underlined words: 'The monkey' is swinging on the tree.
What do little drops of water make, according to the poem?
Fill in the blank with the correct article: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
Which of these is a describing word (adjective)?
Where do you go to buy vegetables in your town?
Choose the correct conjunction to join the words: I like apples ___ bananas.
Which sentence has the correct punctuation?
From 'Seeing without Seeing', write one way we can guess what an object is without looking at it. (1-2 sentences)
questions.answer: We can guess what an object is by touching it with our hands or by smelling it.

questions.question_text: Name any two places you cross on your route 'Between Home and School'.
questions.answer: I cross a large green park and a busy bus stop on my way to school.

questions.question_text: Add '-ing' to the action word 'play' and write a complete sentence using the new word.
questions.answer: Playing. I am playing football with my friends in the evening.

questions.question_text: Why do we say 'We are all Indians' even though we look different and eat different food?
questions.answer: We say 'We are all Indians' because we all live together in one country called India and share the same national flag.

questions.question_text: Why do we write letters to our family members who live far away?
questions.answer: We write letters to tell them how we are doing and to show them that we love and miss them.

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with the correct position words (Prepositions: in, on, under, behind, near): 1. The book is ___ the table. 2. The fish is swimming ___ the water. 3. The shy boy is hiding ___ the door. 4. The dog is sleeping ___ the chair. 5. My school is ___ the park.
Match the naming word (Singular Noun) to its 'Many' form (Plural Noun): 1. Box, 2. Cat, 3. Bush, 4. Mango, 5. Pen. Options: a) Bushes, b) Pens, c) Boxes, d) Cats, e) Mangoes.
You look up at the sky and see a big white cloud. What animal or object does it look like? Write 3 to 4 sentences describing your imaginative cloud shape.
questions.answer: I see a big, fluffy white cloud in the sky. It looks exactly like a giant sleeping rabbit. I can see two long ears and a small round tail made of cotton. It makes me feel happy and I want to pet it.

questions.question_text: Imagine you have a magic bicycle that can fly. Where would you fly to and what would you see on your journey? Write a short paragraph (3-4 sentences).
questions.answer: If my bicycle could fly, I would pedal it all the way up to the shiny stars. I would see the tops of tall green mountains and fly over blue oceans. The birds would fly next to me and sing sweet songs.
